description: Update a webhook endpoint's URL, event-type subscriptions, and/or active flag. Signing secret is NOT rotated by this call — use `rotate_webhook_secret` for that.

campaign_ids.description: Restrict deliveries to these campaign UUIDs (replaces the current set).

clear_campaign_ids.description: Set true to remove the campaign restriction so the webhook fires for all campaigns.

name: update_webhook
title: Update Webhook
